project_context.vibe: Awwwards-level, premium, mysterious yet highly professional. Think Apple meets Stripe with a cyberpunk/neon tech twist.

rules.headings: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Never center align unless strictly needed for hero/balance.
rules.labels: Uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) using the Mono font.
rules.sizes: H1 maxes at text-5xl to text-6xl (clamp). Do not use text-8xl or 9xl for standard headings. Ensure clear hierarchy gaps (e.g., text-5xl heading + text-xl subtitle).

typography.installation_instructions: Import Outfit, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.css.

rules.gradients: Avoid generic full-screen gradients. Use subtle, localized radial glows behind key elements (e.g., behind the hero profile image or CTA buttons).
rules.contrast: Ensure text is highly legible. If placing text over glass/images, use text-shadow or ensure the background overlay is at least bg-black/50.
rules.glassmorphism: Use bg-white/5 or bg-black/40 with backdrop-blur-xl and a strict 1px border of border-white/10. Add a subtle inner shadow for depth.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section paddings to let content breathe.

grid_modes.bento: For Skills and About sections. Use asymmetrical grids (e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) where items span different rows/cols to create visual tension.
grid_modes.projects: Use a heavy, editorial layout for case studies. Alternating left/right massive image showcases with overlapping text cards.

layouts_and_grids.alignment: Prioritize left-alignment for text blocks. Asymmetry over perfect centering.

behaviors.hero_reveal: Signature on-load masked line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion.
behaviors.scroll_spy: Navbar links must update active state based on scroll position.
behaviors.hover_states: Cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase border glow on hover.
behaviors.parallax: Subtle parallax effect on the Hero profile image and Project showcase images.
behaviors.marquee: Use a slow, elegant editorial marquee in the 'About/Manifesto' section with large outline text.

components.Navbar: Sticky at the top, highly blurred glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/50), 1px bottom border. Must contain scroll-spy links.
components.Hero: Kinetic, bold. Contains availability badge (pulsing dot), typing effect for value prop, achievement counters, dual CTAs, and a striking silhouette image treated with neon spot lighting.
components.About: Numbered manifesto chapters. Avoid generic 'Hi I am...' paragraphs. Use bold, high-contrast typography.
components.Skills: Bento grid of hover cards. Categorized (Frontend, Backend, SDET/DevOps).
components.Experience: A clean, vertical timeline with glowing nodes and subtle entry animations on scroll.
components.Projects: Case study style for OMS, MediConnect, SwiftKart. Large spotlight-treated photography.
components.Problem_Solving: An 'Engineering Dashboard' style section visualizing 300+ DSA problems solved. Dense, metric-focused (use Shadcn charts if possible).
components.Contact: Recruiter-focused contact form (real email via standard form action or mailto fallback). Neon submit button.

media_and_images.rules: Never use placeholders. Use provided high-quality Unsplash/Pexels images. Treat images with deliberate overlays or grayscale + hover color reveals.

hero_profile.description: Silhouette of a programmer coding in a dark room - use as main hero visual with cyan/purple lighting

project_oms.description: Dashboard UI representing Order Management System

icons.instructions: Use for UI actions (arrows, links, download). For tech stack, use react-icons if specific brand logos are required, otherwise stick to abstract representations.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over gradients/images passes WCAG standards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme, using the Obsidian background and Neon accents.
Implement smooth momentum scrolling using 'lenis' library. Wrap the app in a Lenis provider.
Use 'framer-motion' extensively for scroll-based reveals, stagger effects, and the kinetic hero.
Do NOT use generic centered text layouts for long paragraphs. Rely on the bento grid and Swiss asymmetry.
For the Problem Solving (DSA) section, build a metric-dense 'dashboard' card rather than a simple text list.
Ensure the contact form is functional (or clearly triggers a mailto link).
Ensure the resume preview/download button links to a public asset.
In index.css, do NOT apply a universal 'transition: all' rule.
Build custom HTML/Tailwind components for the complex marketing layouts (Hero, Bento, Projects) to avoid the rigidity of default Shadcn cards.
